### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/mcp/README.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/skill.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx`  _(via SkillSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via buildMcpBridge (symbol, a top-level function))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via SkillSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/mcp/README.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/skill.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **182** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3e19223bf561694fdbb575dd2490847038916132` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `83fed9c6fc7b6e87f8bd173798d897bced972a49` — the merge of head `63201e823f8db029a3525d239cc9525e9d49e210` into base `3e19223bf561694fdbb575dd2490847038916132`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 83fed9c6fc7b6e87f8bd173798d897bced972a49 && git checkout 83fed9c6fc7b6e87f8bd173798d897bced972a49
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3e19223bf561694fdbb575dd2490847038916132 63201e823f8db029a3525d239cc9525e9d49e210 && git checkout -B drift-repro 3e19223bf561694fdbb575dd2490847038916132 && git merge --no-ff 63201e823f8db029a3525d239cc9525e9d49e210

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3e19223bf561694fdbb575dd2490847038916132
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 3e19223bf561694fdbb575dd2490847038916132` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `63201e823f8db029a3525d239cc9525e9d49e210`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts, skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md + packages/spec/liveness/skill.json, packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts

PR #33188 for card #32885, net diff against `main` 3e19223b (9 files, +128 / -35). Read: the card body and all seven comments, the PR body and file list, the net diff, the check-runs on the head, `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts`, `mcp-server-runtime.ts`, `mcp-http-tools.ts` and `plugin.ts` on `main`, and PR #32880's changeset. The remainder (`content/docs/ai/agents.mdx`, `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`, `packages/mcp/README.md`, the generated `content/docs/references/ai/skill.mdx`, the changeset) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; it was read for contradiction with the two `hits` files and none was found.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set of `SkillSchema`: unchanged. Right.** The `tools` line keeps `z.array(z.string().regex(/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*\*?$/))`; only the `.describe()` argument and JSDoc move. No key added, removed, renamed or re-typed.
- **Published surface that does change: the `tools` description string.** It reaches the generated JSON Schema description and `content/docs/references/ai/skill.mdx` (one row, regenerated in this diff and identical to the source string). No other copy of the old string remains at the head (`git grep "bound by the cloud agent runtime"` finds the source, the reference page and the changeset only). Right.
- **Runtime behaviour: unchanged. Right.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` changes three comment lines inside `buildMcpBridge`; no statement moves. `packages/spec/liveness/skill.json` changes the `_note` and the `tools` entry's `evidence` / `note` strings; `status`, `verifiedAt` and `evidenceScope` are untouched, so no liveness verdict moves and no cloud reading is re-stamped (the ledger's own rule).
- **Published skill `objectstack-ai`: two prose edits, no ceiling raised.** `SKILL.md` is unchanged between 021f00ca and this head, so the dev's token reading (5813 to 5929, ceiling 6801) still describes it.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no

- The changeset `.changeset/32885-skill-tools-binding-prose.md` names `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/skills` patch, `@objectstack/mcp` patch. That matches what the diff publishes: a description string and JSDoc in spec, skill prose in skills, the README that ships in the mcp tarball. Patch is the right level for each; nothing here is a feature or a narrowing.
- `@objectstack/runtime` is not named and need not be: its change is a source comment, and the package rides the fixed group with spec.
- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` stand on both the PR body and the changeset, and both are right: the narrowing itself shipped in 18.4.0 under PR #32880's own `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` changeset (confirmed in `packages/mcp/CHANGELOG.md` on `main`, entry b4f6971 under `## 18.4.0`). So the changeset's "Since 18.4.0" is true, and the card's "lands in the same release as PR #32880" can no longer be met by any PR.
- `Check Changeset`: completed, success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev deviation, two sentences beyond the card's three (the `instructions` JSDoc clause; "reads" to "serves" in the `SKILL.md` row).** Answered: accepted in place by the claim amendment (card comment 6868603309). Both are required by the rewritten paragraphs; leaving either would contradict them.
- **Dev deviation, one added paragraph in `agents.mdx`.** Answered by the same amendment.
- **`open_questions` 1 (four more texts with the same stale claim: extend or family card).** Answered by the amendment: all four are added to this PR's surface, which goes one step past the dev's option A (the ledger and the code comment ride too). Both extra files hold against the code; see ④.
- **The card's "Nothing else in those files changes".** Held apart from the accepted sentences above.
- **Check-runs on the head, as read at review time.** Completed and green: Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Plan Test Core shards, Plan Test UI shards, Auto Label, filter. Still running: Build Core, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Type Check (workspace, source gates, consumer gates, debt ledger), Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Live E2E UI. None failed. This record judges the contract; it does not stand in for the lanes still running, and the dev's 110-command local sweep was taken at 021f00ca, not at this head.
- **Escalated to the seat, not a contract matter:** the card carries no os-dev-report for the rework round that produced this head (the one report names 021f00ca and five files), and the PR is still a draft.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts`** (against `registerSkillPrompts` / `skillBindingServed` on `main` and PR #32880's changeset): holds, sentence by sentence.

- "only when the server it is installed on lists every tool named here, read from that server's own tool registry when the prompt request is answered": `servedToolNames(server)` is called inside both request handlers, and `skillBindingServed` is `binding.every(...)`.
- Plain name / trailing wildcard: `bindingEntryServed` reads `served.has(entry)`, or any `startsWith(stem)` for a wildcard.
- "`action_NAME` (and `action_*`) is also served when `run_action` is listed": `TOOL_FAMILY_DOORS = [['action_', 'run_action']]`, read after the literal or wildcard match, which is the order card comment 6840247483 asked for ("also").
- "A skill that binds no tool is offered as before; `prompts/get` answers a withheld skill as it answers a prompt name no skill derives": an empty or absent binding returns true; a withheld skill is filtered before `lookupSkillPrompt`, so it reaches the same `not-found` branch.
- Reach: `registerSkillPrompts` has one in-repo caller, the per-request HTTP server in `MCPServerRuntime` (line 2663 on `main`), and is exported for hosts; `bridgePrompts` goes through `listSkillPrompts`, which passes `served = undefined`, so no filter. `plugin.ts` calls `bridgePrompts` for the long-lived server. The JSDoc says exactly this.
- The `.describe()` string compresses the same rule without overstating it, and carries no tracker number.
- Break attempts that did not break it: a wildcard whose stem is not in the `action_` family gets no door (the prose claims none); an entry such as a cloud-only platform tool name resolves at authoring time yet is offered on no native server (the last paragraph says so, and keeps `ai-skill-tool-unresolved` as a separate statement); the `surface` and `triggerConditions` field JSDoc and describe strings, unchanged, still agree with the rewritten class JSDoc.

**`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`** (against the card's Expected section, the spec it teaches, and an author binding a skill for an MCP connection; the card names no eval prompt): holds.

- The note under the built-in skills table states the rule, the three ways an entry is served, which servers apply it and which does not, in six lines. Each clause matches the code as above.
- "(the MCP table above)" resolves: the table under "MCP — the open-edition AI path" lists the native tool families, and its `run_action` row already says the stdio bridge serves no action tools, which agrees with "the plugin's own stdio transport lists every skill".
- The file's own Skill Example binds `query_records`, `get_record` and `action_crm_escalate_case`: under the new rule it is offered on a connection with the data and action families, so the skill does not teach an example its own note would withhold.
- `instructions` row, "serves": right, since `tools` is now read as well.

**`packages/spec/liveness/skill.json`** (implementing: the ledger the liveness gate reads for this schema): agrees. The added evidence `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts#skillBindingServed` follows a `;`, so it is a local anchor by the file's own stated rule, and the symbol is an export of that file on `main`. `verifiedAt` is not re-stamped. Spec property liveness: success.

**`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`** (implementing: the `listSkills` seam the JSDoc's HTTP door reads): agrees. "this request's server" is exact for `buildMcpBridge`, whose bridge feeds the per-request server.

Findings:

- **N1 · nit · PR body (prose face).** The body describes the 021f00ca head, not this one. Its Acceptance notes list `connect-mcp.mdx`, `packages/mcp/README.md`, `liveness/skill.json` and `runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` as "left untouched"; all four are changed at this head. The maintainer summary says three texts and the Verification block says five files and "Local gates at 021f00ca". No effect on the tree, but the approving maintainer is told the diff is smaller than it is. Fix on the PR body before the approval is asked for; it does not move the head.
- **N2 · nit · `skill.zod.ts` class JSDoc.** "All three are still validated" follows three bullets, one of which is `instructions`; the sentence means the three wiring keys (`tools`, `surface`, `triggerConditions`), and the lead-in still says "the two halves". Accepted deviation or follow-up; a fix moves the head.
- **N3 · nit · `skill.zod.ts` `tools` JSDoc.** "Bound by the cloud runtime, read by MCP (#3905)" keeps the #3905 tag on a sentence whose "read" half is #32767. Accepted deviation.
- **N4 · nit · `liveness/skill.json`.** The `tools` entry keeps `evidenceScope: cross-repo` with a local anchor beside the cloud ones. That is the file's existing convention (`description` and `instructions` do the same), so nothing to change here.
- **Out of the diff, read not reviewed (carrier: none):** the module header of `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts` on `main` still says the `tools[]` / `surface` half "is consumed by the cloud agent runtime only, and says so in the schema's own JSDoc". After this PR the schema's JSDoc no longer says that of `tools`. The header's next section already states the read, so it is a stale cross-reference, not a wrong rule; a candidate for the same family if another card touches that file.

No must-fix and no should-fix. Nits alone end the round.

- **前提实测:** 文字照 PR #32880 的 changeset 和 `main` 上的 `registerSkillPrompts` / `skillBindingServed` 来写，按卡上 6840247483 的要求；契约复审在代码里逐句核过（6868711489 ④）。
- **门禁 check-runs @ `63201e82`:** 共 68 个，58 success、10 skipped、0 失败（含 Governed Surface Queue Guard、Check Changeset、Spec property liveness、Test Core、Type Check）。本地在本 head 跑了 115 个派生门禁，全部 exit 0；`pnpm lint` 0。SKILL.md 从 5813 token 增到 5929，上限 6801。
- **契约复审:** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS，评论 6868711489，由席位的另一个 agent 按 brief 模板做，写这个 PR 的卡线程没有参与复核。Scope 是 `skill.zod.ts`、`SKILL.md`，加上台账和 runtime 那句注释。nit N1 是 PR 正文还停在旧 head，已经通过改写正文修好（不动 head）。N2–N4 作为接受的偏差：类注释里「All three」的指代、`#3905` 标签放在哪一句、台账 `evidenceScope` 沿用原有写法。
- **接受的偏差:** 卡上三处之外，同文件里另有两句同样过时（`instructions` JSDoc、SKILL.md 中的 reads → serves），加上 agents.mdx 一段，都在认领修订 6868603309 中列出。
- **范围外去向:** `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts` 模块头还有一句过时的交叉引用（「says so in the schema's own JSDoc」）。复核判定只是过时的引用，规则本身没写错，记入 Acceptance notes，下张碰这个文件的卡顺手改。
